description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-tdd test-driven design skill

test_cases.name: Single Skill TDD Design Verification
test_cases.description: Ensures agent-tdd inventories the functional catalog, establishes red-green-refactor steps, and maps port interfaces.
test_cases.prompt: Design the TDD strategy and test impact map for canvas collaboration state transitions.

test_cases.name: Claim ticket and output commit message
test_cases.description: Playing a Linear issue requires In Progress + Cursor assignment, no branch or commit, and a conventional subject that includes the ticket id.
test_cases.prompt: Implement WAY-123 with TDD on main. Leave the diff uncommitted and give me the commit message.

test_cases.name: Until complete is the micro-loop not a waterfall
test_cases.description: Finish-the-ticket still requires one failing catalog case, a confirmed red run, then the smallest production change.
test_cases.prompt: Start the TDD loop and continue until complete.
